title: 401Chain
tagline: 401Chain is a Decentralized pension Dapp based 401(k) Pension scheme
description:
401KChain is Decentralized pension Dapp where any Company can register for their individual pension scheme and their Employee can join their scheme . Contract is deployed on both Scroll Sepolia Testnet and Mantle Testnet . User have options to join respective company Pension DAO by entering its name and they can deposit funds into their scheme and according to 401(k) pension scheme Company will match exact same fund and will Deposit it to the DAO . Only the Company or DAO creator has option to release funds after maturity .
Since due to some issued I wasnt able to develop frontend UI for it . So Im only submitting the contract which I have created
